'''Fabio Conforto''' (13 August 1909 – 24 February 1954) was an Italian [[mathematician]].<ref>{{cite encyclopedia |encyclopedia=[[Treccani]] |title=Fabio Conforto |language=Italian |url=http://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/fabio-conforto/ |access-date=2017-12-10 }}</ref> His contributed to the fields of [[algebraic geometry]], [[projective geometry]] and [[analytic geometry]].
